# Paths that agents read as instructions or configuration.
#
# 'run-review' resets every path matching these entries to its version at the
# PR's base commit before the harness starts, so a pull request cannot rewrite
# the rules it is reviewed by. The PR's own versions are kept as data, with a
# '.txt' suffix, under '.agent-review-context/pr-instruction-files/'.
#
# One git pathspec per line (see 'git help glossary'); blank lines and lines
# starting with '#' are ignored. This is the union over all harnesses: list a
# harness's paths here when adding its adapter (see harnesses/*/README.md).
